text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A crushing defeat... How pathetic. ...I 
wasn't ready at all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I should've been able to do so much more 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Couldn't you have increased the 
training load a bit more? Didn't you stop 
before it even got tough?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If only I'd pushed my training to the 
limit, I might still have had some stamina 
left in my legs at the end...!

There are no absolutes in the world of 
racing. No matter how much you do your 
absolute best, there are times when 
various factors keep you from victory.

“However, even those one-in-a-million 
unforeseen circumstances can be reduced 
with the right countermeasures.”
choice_data_list:
It's a staggering number, but let's take 
it one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I think I see what I need to do 
now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The road to victory may be endless. 
...Still—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I will not stop my stride. As long as I 
keep moving forward... I will definitely 
reach it!
choice_data_list:
With feelings that strong, I'm sure you'll 
be fine.
I'll guide you so you can win!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation

reach it!
choice_data_list:
With feelings that strong, I'm sure you'll 
be fine.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. A race you're guaranteed to win 
might not exist, after all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even so, my heart is screaming that it 
wants to win. ...I will not give up!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will carry out every single 
strategy that Trainer and I formulate 
together.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You believe in my hard work more than 
anyone else. ...That's why—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'll crawl my way back up too, just watch 
me!"
